findings.desc: Fail-open overclaim detector: hasFullRoadmapClaim returns false immediately when the text contains roadmap not complete before checking later explicit full-roadmap claims (packages/main/src/core/parent-roadmap-totality.ts:548-558). Repro command: node packages/main/dist/cli.js parent_roadmap_status {case:partial,summaryText:Parent governance complete; roadmap is not complete. Remaining child-story-needed rows: M5. Full roadmap complete: all M4-M12 rows are done.,mode:enforce,json:true}. Observed claim.allowed=true, blocking=false, proofstoryBinding.status=pass even though rollup.allRowsClosed=false and openRows=M4,M5. This violates the parent roadmap gate contract that enforce-mode summary and handoff consumers must block explicit full-roadmap wording unless all rows are closed.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 7457ea190: full-roadmap detection no longer short-circuits on roadmap-not-complete wording. Verified contradictory overclaim exits 1 with parent_roadmap_status mode=enforce; parent-roadmap-totality-smoke --case=claim-consumer passes.

findings.desc: Enforce-mode parent-roadmap commands do not fail closed when the evaluator reports a blocking overclaim. Repro command: node packages/main/dist/cli.js parent_roadmap_status {case:partial,summaryText:Full roadmap complete: all rows are done.,mode:enforce,json:true}. The process exited with code 0 while the JSON contained claim.blocking=true and proofstoryBinding.blocking=true/status=fail. Existing ProofStory diagnostics use enforceOrRender to throw when mode=enforce and blocking is true (packages/main/src/handlers/proofstory.ts:53-55,529-553), but parent_roadmap_status/evaluate simply stringify or render the result (packages/main/src/handlers/parent-roadmap.ts:64-78). This means automation can treat a blocking parent-roadmap overclaim as a successful command.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 7457ea190: parent_roadmap_status/evaluate throw in mode=enforce when claim or proofstory binding is blocking. Verified overclaim command exits 1 and smoke --case=cli passes.

findings.desc: Parent-roadmap totality can still be proven against a shrunken caller-supplied ledger instead of the original B-5082 milestone inventory. B-9fc5 requires ProofStory controls such as originalIntentSnapshot/milestoneLedger/slicePlan to keep the child-row inventory from shrinking (docs/requirements/decisions/parent-roadmap-intent-totality-gate-execution-plan.md:168-190), but evaluateParentRoadmapLedger derives allRowsClosed solely from ledger.rows (packages/main/src/core/parent-roadmap-totality.ts:511-528) and evaluateParentRoadmapProofStoryBinding only requires a snapshot plus some acceptanceBindings, without proving those bindings cover every parent row or the original milestone ledger (packages/main/src/core/parent-roadmap-totality.ts:615-645). A ledger that omits M5-M12 but closes its supplied rows can therefore receive full_roadmap_complete/full-roadmap-claim, which defeats the intent-totality gate boundary.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 7457ea190: requiredRowIds plus proofstoryContract milestoneIds bind expected row inventory; missing required rows produce invalid missing_required_row results and no full-roadmap claim. Verified by parent-roadmap-totality-smoke --case=evaluator and full smoke.

findings.desc: The summary overclaim detector lets contradictory wording bypass the full-roadmap guard when the same text also says the roadmap is not complete. hasFullRoadmapClaim returns false as soon as it sees roadmap-not-complete wording (packages/main/src/core/parent-roadmap-totality.ts:548-558), before checking whether the text also contains explicit full-roadmap-complete wording. That means text like "Full roadmap complete; roadmap not complete. Remaining child-story-needed rows: M5" is not classified as a full-roadmap claim, despite the B-9fc5 contract requiring any full-completion wording to be invalid unless allRowsClosed=true (docs/requirements/decisions/parent-roadmap-intent-totality-gate-execution-plan.md:20-24,53-55). The smoke only covers clean overclaim and clean partial wording, not the contradictory combined case (packages/main/src/tasks/parent-roadmap-totality-smoke.ts:382-397).
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 7457ea190 with sentence-aware negation/disclaimer handling plus contradictory wording smoke. Verified parent_roadmap_status contradictory text exits 1 in enforce mode.

findings.desc: Verification coverage claims missing-row coverage, but parent-roadmap-totality-smoke has no dedicated missing closure-evidence negative control. The smoke CaseName list has no missing case; runEvaluator asserts partial/open, blocked, invalid deferral, and stale rows, but never evaluates a closed-by-implementation or closed-by-existing-evidence row with closureEvidence: [] nor asserts evidenceState=missing, reasonCodes includes missing_closure_evidence, or the attach-closure-evidence next action. Current runtime has that branch, so a regression in missing closure-evidence handling could pass the smoke and recorded CHK-003/CHK-008 evidence even though the plan contract requires missing evidence to prevent full-roadmap claims. Source refs: packages/main/src/tasks/parent-roadmap-totality-smoke.ts:26, packages/main/src/tasks/parent-roadmap-totality-smoke.ts:358, packages/main/src/tasks/parent-roadmap-totality-smoke.ts:364, packages/main/src/tasks/parent-roadmap-totality-smoke.ts:376, packages/main/src/core/parent-roadmap-totality.ts:419, docs/requirements/decisions/parent-roadmap-intent-totality-gate-execution-plan.md:48, docs/requirements/decisions/parent-roadmap-intent-totality-gate-execution-plan.md:279.
